provenance.notes: Training-only stage-zero curriculum. It alternates the two locked impact directions on the exact recoverable plant so every successful episode can contribute post-recovery actor data. It makes no robustness claim; variation remains assigned to quadruped-resilient-mission-v1 and independent held-out Benchmarks.
